race.comment: FLEETING BOOM (3) goes on top after leading pillar-to-post to shed her maiden tag here last month. Has been kept fresh for this and retains gun hoop Benny Thompson from a favourable draw. Can win again. OLIVONI (1) is the class runner coming back from Saturday Open company at Eagle Farm, where she ad excuses when slow to recover. Her first-up second when beaten a neck reads well and she is fitter third-up. TRINITY STATE (8) is another likely type, following up her win on debut at Grafton with a narrow defeat at Port Mac. Suspect this is tougher but Newman's claim gets in her light and she's drawn to settle handy. Not underestimating. AURORA BLAZE (5) disappointed last time on heavy ground but her two prior efforts were good. Keeping safe.
